preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 2 recounts the wilderness passage past Edom, Moab, and Ammon, and the defeat of Sihon. 4QDeutᵈ (4Q31) preserves a substantial run of 2:24–3:14 and is the principal Qumran witness for this material. 11QDeut and 4QDeutᶜ also attest fragments. The text broadly tracks the MT with only orthographic variation.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. 4QDeutᵈ shows the typical Qumran-orthographic plene tendency (longer spellings) but the consonantal text agrees with the MT throughout the preserved passages.
preamble.scroll_condition: 4QDeutᵈ is well preserved across vv. 24–37, providing a continuous reading of the Sihon narrative.

variant_notes: The command to cross the Wadi Arnon and engage Sihon is preserved; tracks MT.
